name: gemini-usage-monitor
description: Monitor your Google Antigravity IDE model quotas (Gemini and Claude/GPT, 5-hour and weekly) in the status bar with alerts and recommendations. Reads Antigravity's own local language server; nothing leaves your machine.

commands.title: Gemini Usage: Save Raw Usage Response

geminiUsage.autoFetch.description: Automatically read usage from Antigravity's local language server on startup and at regular intervals

geminiUsage.refreshInterval.description: How often (in minutes) to read usage from Antigravity

geminiUsage.showInStatusBar.description: Show Gemini usage in the status bar

geminiUsage.compactStatusBar.description: Use a compact status-bar label: '<icon> X% (current) Y% (week)' instead of '<icon> Gemini Usage: X% (current) Y% (week)'.

geminiUsage.thresholds.moderate.description: Usage percentage at which the Moderate urgency level is triggered

geminiUsage.thresholds.high.description: Usage percentage at which the High urgency level is triggered

geminiUsage.thresholds.critical.description: Usage percentage at which the Critical urgency level is triggered

geminiUsage.notificationTimeoutSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) Gemini Usage notifications stay on screen before auto-dismissing. Set this so notifications never stack while VS Code is in the background. Manual dismiss via the X button is always available.

geminiUsage.colors.moderate.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Moderate level. Use a hex color (e.g. #cca700) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

geminiUsage.colors.high.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the High level. Use a hex color (e.g. #f0643c) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

geminiUsage.colors.critical.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Critical level. Use a hex color (e.g. #e05555) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

enumDescriptions: Evaluate thresholds against whichever window is highest across every Antigravity model group (Gemini and Claude/GPT)
Evaluate thresholds against the Gemini 5-hour (Current Session) usage
Evaluate thresholds against the Gemini Weekly usage
geminiUsage.thresholdMetric.description: Which usage metric the urgency thresholds and notifications are evaluated against
